zxcvbn-ts browser distributions
https://github.com/zxcvbn-ts/zxcvbn

Packages from the npm registry:
- @zxcvbn-ts/core 3.0.4
- @zxcvbn-ts/language-common 3.0.4
- @zxcvbn-ts/language-en 3.0.2

Each packaged dist/zxcvbn-ts.min.js is included under its package name.
Source-map references were removed because the maps are not distributed.

The English common-word frequency data is derived from the 2018 English list
in FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, based on the OPUS OpenSubtitles corpus.
https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords/tree/master/content/2018/en
https://opus.nlpl.eu/datasets/OpenSubtitles
The frequency data is licensed under Open Data Commons Attribution 1.0.
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1-0/
The zxcvbn-ts upstream attribution is documented at
https://zxcvbn-ts.github.io/zxcvbn/guide/migration/#new-commonwords-source
